newsitem.title: TURKEY: ISTANBUL GOLD SLIGHTLY FIRMER, TRADE QUIET.
newsitem.headline: ISTANBUL GOLD SLIGHTLY FIRMER, TRADE QUIET.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange slipped to 1,075 kg from Wednesday's 1,730 kg in quiet trade, dealers said.
Gold closed slightly firmer at $320.00 an ounce and 1,681,000 lira per gram, compared to $319.60 and 1,679,000 lira as limited supplies of gold reached the market.

"The market expects gold to weaken in the coming days, so there isn't much demand from the market. On the other hand, only a few banks have stocks to sell, but are holding on for the moment, temporarily forcing prices up," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira closed firmer at 163,050 to the dollar, versus the previous close of 163,190 as the dollar weakened in the world markets.
Of the day's trade, 565 kg took place in the morning session and 510 in the afternoon, with 52.1 percent of the total conducted in lira terms.
